about: Arms of step-look-step (steplook.py, step.sh). bursts = [seconds, the furthest it has been seen to move, m]: the planner never picks a burst that could pass the stop. Round 2 (2026-11-22): the robot carries the 3000 mAh backpack (battery-v2m5-20261121). The step015_v2m5 table is the robot-brain sim's furthest per duration over 7 conditions (cmu/step/results/round2/runtime_bursts_candidate.json); replace it with servo odometry from the first robot logs (odom_report.py). walk61's table is from the old body; on this body walk61 creeps backward at zero command in the sim.
